system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Rope Access Technicians (Cordistes)
proposals.buyer_persona: Industrial climbers and rope access professionals who take extreme pride in their dangerous, highly skilled work. They love showing off their lifestyle, rigging gear, and inside humor about gravity, wind, and safety inspectors.
product_angles: KDP Rope Access Hours Logbook (crucial for tracking IRATA/SPRAT certification levels)
Funny niche stickers on Redbubble focusing on rigging knots, carabiners, and height humor
Technical rigging reference pocket guides on KDP
proposals.first_test_product: IRATA/SPRAT-compliant Work Hours Logbook with a rugged, professional cover design on KDP

proposals.name: 1:64 Post-Apocalyptic Car Skirmish Upgrades (Gaslands-compatible)
proposals.buyer_persona: Tabletop skirmish gamers who buy cheap Hot Wheels/Matchbox toy cars and customize them with weapons, armor, and rams to play post-apocalyptic car combat games like Gaslands.
product_angles: Cults3D parametric STL packs for 1:64 scale weapons (miniguns, rockets, harpoons)
OpenSCAD customizable rams, armor plates, and engine blocks
KDP Campaign Tracker & Dashboard sheets for custom car builds
proposals.first_test_product: A set of 15 modular, high-detail weapon and armor upgrades optimized for 1:64 scale resin printing on Cults3D

proposals.name: Miniature Painting Backlog & Project Tracking
proposals.buyer_persona: Warhammer, D&D, and board game enthusiasts who own hundreds of unpainted miniatures (their 'Pile of Shame') and need structured, visual ways to plan paint schemes, track color recipes, and gamify their painting progress.
product_angles: KDP Miniature Painting Project Planner with recipe cards, paint brand checklists, and speed-painting trackers
Redbubble humorous merch poking fun at the 'Pile of Shame' and buying more plastic than one can paint
SVG SVG-stencils or printable masking templates for airbrushing
proposals.first_test_product: A 120-page 'Miniature Painting Recipe & Backlog Tracker' workbook on KDP with structured template layouts

proposals.name: French Mountain Passes Minimalist Altitude Profiles
proposals.buyer_persona: Passionate road cyclists, triathletes, and hikers who travel to the French Alps, Pyrenees, or Massif Central to climb iconic mountain passes (Cols like Galibier, Tourmalet, Ventoux) and want minimalist, high-end souvenirs of their achievement.
product_angles: Minimalist vector altitude profile posters on Redbubble (representing distance, average gradient, peak altitude)
KDP Logbooks for French cycling climbs with space to record times, dates, and weather conditions
Customizable B2B poster templates for local bike rental shops and regional tourism offices near famous climbs
proposals.first_test_product: A series of 5 minimalist altitude profile vector designs of the most famous French Alpine Cols on Redbubble (poster and sticker formats)

proposals.name: Solo RPG Journaling (Thousand Year Old Vampire & Hex-Crawl style)
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo tabletop roleplayers who play narrative journaling RPGs. They spend hours writing down stories, mapping fantasy lands, and rolling dice alone, demanding high-aesthetic journals that feel immersive (gothic, fantasy, or sci-fi retro themes).
product_angles: KDP Hex-crawl mapping notebooks with dot-grid and hexagonal grids on facing pages
Structured journaling templates specifically optimized for solo vampire or space-explorer journaling games
Minimalist gothic-themed prompt cards published as PDF print-and-play files
proposals.first_test_product: A high-aesthetic 'Solo RPG Campaign Cartography & Journaling Notebook' featuring alternating hex-grid and lined parchment-style pages on KDP

proposals.name: COBOL & Legacy Systems Software Engineers
proposals.buyer_persona: Enterprise developers maintaining massive legacy COBOL, Fortran, or mainframe architectures. They have a dry, cynical sense of humor about keeping the global banking system alive using 50-year-old code, and love highly technical inside jokes that younger web developers don't understand.
product_angles: Redbubble dark-humor developer apparel and stickers ('COBOL: Keeping the world running since 1959', 'I read dead code')
KDP 'Legacy Code Debugging Journal' with funny warning pages
Minimalist schematics posters of vintage mainframe architectures
proposals.first_test_product: A collection of 10 highly technical, text-based legacy developer inside-joke stickers on Redbubble
